profile.legalName: Prescott-Joseph Center for Community Enhancement, Inc.
profile.summary: A nonprofit community resource center in the Prescott neighborhood of West Oakland, organized in 1995 in a former convent. It offers family support, health and wellness, youth development and community programs, including a food pantry, a preschool, a youth mentoring and computer learning program, and a mobile health program called the Northern California Breathmobile Project. Staff serve people in English and Spanish.
